verses.text: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

segments.text: When Israel went forth out of Egypt,
The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.text: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.

segments.text: The sea saw it, and fled;

verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?

segments.text: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest?
Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?

verses.text: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?

segments.text: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams;

verses.text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,

segments.text: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord,
At the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.text: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.

segments.text: Who turned the rock into a pool of water,
The flint into a fountain of waters.
